svg.title: Molecule portfolio visual direction
svg.desc: A black, mint, and ghost-white typography specimen for Russell Jahn, software engineer and artist. Bold condensed type sits beside a sparse geometric connection motif. Three editorial project labels reference Paper Ghost, Enflux, and Blizzard. This is a direction study rather than a finished website.
